# Google Labs

> Google Labs is the home for experimental AI tools and creative projects exploring generative AI, music generation, image creation, and cultural exploration.

Google Labs showcases cutting-edge AI experiments and prototypes developed by Google, enabling users to explore innovative applications across creative, productivity, and cultural domains. The platform fosters community collaboration through Discord, Reddit, and X, connecting artists, developers, and AI enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- AI Experiments
- Creative Tools
- Music Generation
- Image Generation
- Cultural Exploration
- Experimental Products
- Artist Partnerships
- AI Collaborations
- Google Arts & Culture
- MusicFX
- ImageFX
- Stitch
- ProducerAI
- Project Genie

## Getting Started

- [Google Labs Homepage](https://labs.google): Google Labs homepage showcasing latest AI experiments and experimental prototypes
- [About Google Labs](https://labs.google/about): Overview of Google Labs mission, AI projects, and community engagement
- [Explore AI Tools & Experiments](https://labs.google/experiments): Directory of Google Labs AI tools including Stitch, ProducerAI, and cultural projects

## Creative AI Tools

- [Project Genie](https://labs.google/projectgenie): Experimental prototype for creating and exploring infinitely diverse worlds
- [CC: AI Productivity Agent](https://labs.google/cc): AI productivity agent for Gmail with email briefing and Calendar/Drive integration

## Community & Collaborations

- [Lab Sessions](https://labs.google/sessions): Featured AI collaborations with artists like Shankar Mahadevan using Music AI Sandbox
- [Google Labs Community](https://labs.google/community): Community hub connecting users via Discord, Reddit, X for AI project collaboration
